title.original: SWE-Universe: Scale Real-World Verifiable Environments to Millions
title.zh: SWE-Universe：将真实世界的可验证环境扩展到数百万
title.en: SWE-Universe: Scale Real-World Verifiable Environments to Millions

inclusion_reason.zh: SWE-Universe 的构建 Agent、自验证和反作弊门控能够批量生产真实 PR 可验证环境，属于训练资源工厂而非单题 Agent。
inclusion_reason.en: SWE-Universe's builder agent, self-verification, and anti-hacking gates mass-produce verifiable real-PR environments, making it a training-resource factory rather than a single-task agent.

abstract.zh: SWE-Universe 从 GitHub Pull Request 自动构建可验证的软件工程环境，以定制构建 Agent 和自校验机制把真实任务扩展到百万量级。
abstract.en: SWE-Universe automatically turns GitHub pull requests into verifiable software-engineering environments, using a custom builder agent and self-checking to approach million-scale real tasks.

problem.zh: 从真实仓库自动产出训练环境常因构建失败、验证器薄弱和单任务成本过高而难以规模化。
problem.en: Automatic construction from real repositories is difficult to scale because builds fail often, verifiers are weak, and per-task cost is prohibitive.

approach.zh: 定制模型驱动的构建 Agent 迭代配置仓库、生成验证条件并自检，同时在循环内检测针对验证器的投机或绕过行为。
approach.en: A custom-model builder agent iteratively configures repositories, creates verification conditions, self-checks them, and detects verifier hacking inside the construction loop.

system_design.zh: 流水线摄取 PR 与仓库快照，调度构建 Agent 进入隔离环境，经过迭代构建、自验证和反作弊门控后发布可训练任务。
system_design.en: The pipeline ingests pull requests and repository snapshots, runs the builder in isolation, and publishes tasks only after iterative build, self-verification, and anti-hacking gates.

key_results.zh: 框架产出大规模多语言真实 SWE 环境，并在中期训练、强化学习和高端代码 Agent 上显示明显价值。
key_results.en: The framework produces a very large multilingual collection of real SWE environments and shows value for agentic mid-training, reinforcement learning, and strong coding agents.

limitations.zh: 规模不等于验证质量；自动构建模型和反作弊器可能共享盲点，GitHub PR 分布也不能代表全部软件维护活动。
limitations.en: Scale does not guarantee verifier quality; the builder and anti-hacking checks may share blind spots, and GitHub pull requests do not represent all software-maintenance work.
